## Change

Describe the observable change and the reason for it.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`
- [ ] `pnpm run pack:check`
- [ ] `pnpm run readme:build` when README facts, copy, or assets changed
- [ ] PowerShell 5.1 and 7 launcher self-tests when launcher files changed

## Safety

- [ ] Primary-checkout mutation rules remain unchanged or are explained here
- [ ] New logs, fixtures, and screenshots contain no private paths or credentials
